title: Loom model card measurements (info.json), schema loom-card/3
description: The data of a loom-fun card that has no other home: per GPU (devices): measurements, gate evidence, the device and Loom SDK that measured, the baseline, dates and versions. What the package is comes from its own files and is never repeated here: sources, revisions, files, sha256 and sizes from model.json.lock; services, context, rows, max_tokens and drafting depth from model.json; chat features, the drafter and the generating loom-skills commit and SDK from llm_config.json. render_card.py renders README.md from all four. Unknown values are null or absent (rendered as not measured / no evidence / unknown), never guessed.
$comment: Compatibility: the schema string changes only on a breaking change. Readers ignore metric names, gate names and object keys they don't know, so adding a metric, a gate, an optional key or a new enum value of source.kind keeps loom-card/3. Removing or renaming a key, changing a key's type or meaning, or making a key required is breaking and bumps the schema to loom-card/4. loom-card/3 moved gates, performance and roofline under devices.<gpu>; loom-card/2 cards read as the strix-halo device (card_lib.normalize).

repo.description: The Hugging Face repo of this card

card.description: Choices about the card itself that no package file records

license.description: The checkpoint's license tag (from its Hugging Face card at publish time)

tags.description: Front matter tags after the ones the package implies

output.description: loom-fetch --output directory, when not model.json's model id

memory_bytes.description: loom-serve --memory_bytes the card was validated with, when model.json carries none

features.description: Every feature row as the card shows it, so a reader needs no other file: status yes, no (the upstream model has it, Loom lacks it), n/a (the upstream model has none) or unknown (not determined; rendered as a neutral ?, never red), and its value (speculative_decoding yes with a null method: a drafter is available upstream but not enabled). Written by make_info.py build from the package, the upstream model (vision, audio, chat template), the sampling gate and evidence (an old report stating greedy-only decoding); render_card.py shows these over what it derives itself

card_generator.description: loom-skills commit of the card scripts that wrote this info.json and its README ('unknown' if not a git checkout); passed in, never read by the renderer from the environment

package.description: Only for a package built before build.py stamped llm_config.json 'generator': what generated its programs, as recovered afterwards. Ignored when llm_config.json has the stamp.

sources.description: Where evidence came from, by id (referenced by performance sessions and gates)

devices.description: Per GPU, keyed by id (card_lib.GPUS). Added in loom-card/3: loom-card/2 held gates, performance and roofline at the top level, which readers take as the strix-halo entry (card_lib.normalize).

report.description: REPORT.md in the repo: generated by render_card.py from this file, or attached as written (an older card's narrative report, a factory run's REPORT.md)

status.description: Where work on this model stands, when not active: paused (work stopped; the card shows what was reached). Optional key, loom-card/2.

next_steps.description: What would be done next if work continued, one short markdown line each; README.md ends with them under Next steps. Optional key, loom-card/2.

gpu.description: What the card records for one GPU: measurements, gate evidence, roofline and how the package is served on it. A GPU without results carries a state.

state.description: not_measured: this package has no results on this GPU yet (the card says so and shows no numbers). unsupported: the package does not fit this GPU (required_bytes; the card says so). Absent: the GPU has results.

required_bytes.description: unsupported only: the memory the package needs on this GPU (weights, KV cache at the native context, headroom)

memory_bytes.description: loom-serve --memory_bytes on this GPU when it differs from the package value (model.json or card.memory_bytes): the GPU memory bounds the elastic pool

served_context.description: Tokens per request this GPU serves when its memory budget holds less KV cache than the native context needs; the same package serves it, --memory_bytes bounds the pool. Absent: the native context.

name.description: The engine compared with, e.g. llama.cpp

args.description: The exact server arguments (model path, host and port left out)

differs.description: Notes the card must show: a cell llama.cpp cannot run (not supported, with the reason) or a Loom-side limitation, one line each

baselines.description: Further llama.cpp backends measured with the same workloads, by backend name (vulkan: the official ggml-org release). Optional key, loom-card/2. Never a headline value or a guardrail input (card_lib.card_metrics reads sessions only); rendered as one more DevLab column.

args.description: The exact server arguments (model path, host and port left out)

sha256.description: sha256 of the release archive the measurement ran

differs.description: Server settings that differ from the main baseline's or that this backend could not run, with the reason, one line each (never silently changed)

session.description: One baseline-only measurement session (the latest replaces the earlier one); metrics hold the engine's value and per-run values only

programs_sha256.description: card_lib.programs_sha256 of the package the run fetched (its GGUF, drafter and settings came from it)

sessions.description: Measurement sessions in evidence order, all from AMD DevLab Dispatch (source kind devlab or factory: devlab-perf jobs, scripted DevLab ports, loom-factory). Per metric the last session that measured it is the card's value (card_lib.card_metrics).

gates.description: Per gate name the most recent evidence. Gates the package's features make applicable but that have no entry render as no evidence.

roofline.description: The hardware ceiling of each performance metric, computed from the GGUF by loom-roofline's roofline.py (make_info.py roofline). Added in loom-card/2 (optional key).

bandwidth_bytes_per_s.description: memory bandwidth the decode ceilings divide by

peak_flops.description: peak FLOP/s the prefill ceilings divide by

script.description: the script, relative to the loom-skills checkout

skills_commit.description: loom-skills commit of the checkout ('unknown' if not a git checkout)

checkpoint.description: the GGUF file the ceilings were computed from

oneOf.description: drafted rows (decode, 4 streams): ceiling = verify passes per second x tokens_per_pass = 1 + acceptance x depth; the drafter's own passes are not counted (an upper bound)

acceptance.description: the spec gate's acceptance (the card's spec_acceptance) when computed: the fallback for drafted rows whose session recorded no acceptance of its own

kind.description: local: a developer's machine (gates only: never a performance session); devlab: a workflow on AMD DevLab Dispatch (nightly-gates, devlab-port, devlab-perf: the card's performance); factory: the loom-factory workflow

hrx_loom.description: The Loom SDK that served the model

device.description: machine_info.py detect_device(): values from the hardware and the OS release only

hrx_loom.description: A Loom SDK identity: install_loom.sh's loom-install.json, or version + dist-info RECORD fingerprint
The package version (every build says 0.1.0 today)

fingerprint.description: First 16 hex of sha256(dist-info RECORD) when nothing better is known

recovered.description: Established after the fact rather than recorded at the time

basis.description: How a recovered value was established

over_context.description: metric -> prompt tokens (null: not counted) of a long document the Loom server refused as over its context (make_info.py perf; card_lib.over_context)

loom_runs.description: per-run values the card value summarizes

acceptance.description: speculative decoding: accepted / proposed drafted tokens of this metric's own Loom requests (mean of the runs; perf.py, c4_steady.py), the acceptance its roofline ceiling counts

level.description: gates.sh LEVEL the evidence ran at

detail.description: a count from the gate's own output (e.g. 66/66), or null

ceiling.description: tokens per second at the hardware limit (null: not computable, e.g. a drafted row without acceptance)

single_pass.description: the ceiling without speculative decoding (drafted rows only)

efficiency.description: the fraction of the ceiling tuned Loom ports have demonstrated for this kind of metric (roofline.py EFF / EFF_DRAFTED); the far-from-roofline guardrail compares against it

acceptance.description: drafted rows: the acceptance this ceiling counts

acceptance_from.description: session: measured in the same session as the card's value of this row; spec_gate: the spec gate's (its text can accept more or less than the row's)

basis.description: mixture-of-experts 4-stream row: the ceiling assumes the four streams route to the same experts (the hard bound a run may not exceed)

value.description: structured detail the renderer formats (string, number, object or null)
